---
title: "embedpdf with a large PDF"
resources:

  - "files/large-2.pdf"
---

Both embeds show a PDF of 14 pages and over 128 KB (`pdfinfo` and `wc -c`
give its size). `tests/make_large_pdf.sh` builds it from
`files/large-source.md`, and each page has a heading that no other page
holds. `files/large-2.pdf` is a copy of `files/large.pdf`. PDF.js loads a PDF
of this size by byte ranges if the server allows it. The checks in `tests/`
use this page to check that path and the hidden text of each page.
